# Upstream workflow fixture

`upstream-workflow.md` is copied verbatim from `elixir/WORKFLOW.md` in
[openai/symphony](https://github.com/openai/symphony/tree/be10a1b79df723d6d7612b5651c8522704dafb2e),
commit `be10a1b79df723d6d7612b5651c8522704dafb2e`, provided under the
[Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).

Tests only parse and render this fixture. They do not execute its hooks, clone its
repository or access the real Linear project or credentials.
